{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert revenue from string to float, removing commas
# First, confirm that all revenue values are valid numeric strings with commas
print("Validating revenue format:")
print(data['revenue'].str.contains(r'^\d{1,3}(,\d{3})*\.\d{2}$').all())

# Now convert revenue to float
data['revenue_numeric'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check that the conversion worked
print("\nSample of converted revenue:")
print(data['revenue_numeric'].head())

# Check for QA orders with 999999.99
print("\nNumber of rows with revenue == 999999.99:", (data['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
